name: eink-pi-zero
description: E-ink display examples using JSX and TypeScript on Raspberry Pi Zero 2.

scripts.test:snapshot: docker build -t eink-test -f Dockerfile.test . && docker run --rm eink-test
scripts.test:snapshot:update: docker build -t eink-test -f Dockerfile.test . && docker run --rm -e UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1 -v ./examples:/app/examples -v ./dashboard:/app/dashboard eink-test
